mapper.sql: SELECT ip.id, ip.name, ip.carrier, ip.apply_url, ip.status, ip.business_no, ip.contact_name, ip.contact_phone, ip.contract_start, ip.contract_end, ip.memo, (SELECT count(*) FROM internet_product x WHERE x.internet_partner_id = ip.id) AS product_count FROM internet_partner ip
mapper.select: INSERT INTO internet_partner (name, carrier, apply_url, status, business_no, contact_name, contact_phone, contract_start, contract_end, memo) VALUES (#{p.name}, #{p.carrier}, #{p.applyUrl}, #{p.status}, #{p.businessNo}, #{p.contactName}, #{p.contactPhone}, #{p.contractStart}, #{p.contractEnd}, #{p.memo}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE internet_partner SET name = #{p.name}, carrier = #{p.carrier}, apply_url = #{p.applyUrl}, status = #{p.status}, business_no = #{p.businessNo}, contact_name = #{p.contactName}, contact_phone = #{p.contactPhone}, contract_start = #{p.contractStart}, contract_end = #{p.contractEnd}, memo = #{p.memo}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{p.id}
mapper.sql: SELECT x.id, x.carrier, x.product_type, x.name, x.monthly_price, array_to_string(x.benefits, '|') AS benefits, x.internet_partner_id, ip.name AS partner_name, ip.status AS partner_status, x.apply_url, ip.apply_url AS partner_apply_url, x.sort_order, x.exposed FROM internet_product x LEFT JOIN internet_partner ip ON ip.id = x.internet_partner_id
mapper.select: WHERE x.product_type = #{productType} ORDER BY x.product_type, x.sort_order, x.id

INSERT INTO internet_product (carrier, product_type, name, monthly_price, benefits, internet_partner_id, apply_url, sort_order, exposed) VALUES (#{carrier}, #{productType}, #{name}, #{monthlyPrice}, #{benefits,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{partnerId}, #{applyUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{exposed}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE internet_product SET carrier = #{carrier}, product_type = #{productType}, name = #{name}, monthly_price = #{monthlyPrice}, benefits = #{benefits,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, internet_partner_id = #{partnerId}, apply_url = #{applyUrl}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, exposed = #{exposed}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM internet_product x JOIN internet_partner ip ON ip.id = x.internet_partner_id WHERE ip.id = #{partnerId} AND ip.status = 'ENDED' AND x.exposed
mapper.update: UPDATE internet_partner SET status = 'ENDED', updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND contract_end IS NOT NULL AND contract_end < #{today}
